name: polyemesis-web

scripts.build: astro check && astro build && node scripts/check-build.mjs

//overrides: lodash-es is pulled in by chevrotain, which mermaid 12 added. Versions up to 4.17.23 carry GHSA-r5fr-rjxr-66jc (code injection via _.template) and GHSA-f23m-r3pf-42rh (prototype pollution in _.unset/_.omit); 4.18.1 is clean. chevrotain has not moved, and npm audit fix would downgrade mermaid back to 11 rather than fix the dependency. The override DEDUPES -- one lodash-es at 4.18.1, no nested copy -- so nothing is shadowed. REMOVE THIS once chevrotain ships a release depending on >=4.18.1. -- undici@7.29.0 is pinned exactly by miniflare (through wrangler) and carries GHSA-rfgv-xxqx-mfg5 and nine more advisories fixed in 7.29.1; the key names only that version, so jsdom's undici@8 is untouched. REMOVE THIS once wrangler's miniflare depends on undici >=7.29.1 (miniflare in wrangler 4.145.0 already does). -- sharp@0.35.4 is pinned exactly by miniflare (through wrangler) and carries GHSA-wq5f-xc86-pv6w, fixed in 0.35.5; astro's own range (^0.35.4) already accepts 0.35.5, so the key names only the pinned copy. REMOVE THIS once wrangler's miniflare depends on sharp >=0.35.5.
